title: Administrative Sanction — NH-48 Widening Project
department: Ministry of Road Transport & Highways / NHAI
text: Administrative sanction for the NH-48 Widening Project records a sanctioned amount of ₹18.4 crore. The project contractor is ABC Infrastructure Ltd. The original completion date recorded in the sanction is 30 September 2024.

title: Administrative Sanction — Government School Repair Programme
text: Administrative sanction approved ₹42 lakh for repair and accessibility works at Government Senior Secondary School, Ward 17. The sanction covers classroom repairs, toilets and boundary-wall restoration.

title: Work Order — School Repair Programme
text: Work order issued to Sunrise Works for the approved repair package. The scheduled completion date is 30 June 2026.

title: Completion Inspection Note
text: Inspection note records partial completion of classroom and toilet works. Boundary-wall restoration remains pending. The note does not state the total expenditure incurred to date.

title: Public Expenditure Statement
text: The public expenditure statement lists ₹27.6 lakh as expenditure booked against the school repair programme to date.
